item.title: Sparse Attention for Long-Context Summarization
item.description: arXiv:2610.11111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a sparse attention mechanism that reduces the memory cost of long-context summarization by 60 percent while matching the ROUGE scores of dense attention on three benchmarks.
